definition: to be known by many people for something
description: At night under rows of red paper lanterns, a smiling young cook in a white headband, white t-shirt and black apron tosses a big bunch of noodles with peppers high into the air from a wok over a bright blue gas flame. The noodles fall back into the wok, he stirs them and then lifts a long bunch up high again. Behind him a crowd holding bowls cheers and films him. Next to him a young woman in a mustard top ladles soup into paper cups beside stacked bamboo steamers.

to cook noodles in a pan
